# Source: Wurzblatt (Wallpaper Design)

This GameCore theme is derived from a **specific, real, public-domain work**—not a generated palette.

## Work

- **Title:** Wurzblatt (Wallpaper Design)
- **Artist / culture:** Designed by Dagobert Peche (Austrian, 1887–1923) Manufactured by F. O. Schmidt Austria, Vienna
- **Date:** c. 1915
- **Style:** Modernism
- **Classification:** textile
- **Department:** Textiles
- **AIC artwork ID:** 153153
- **Artwork page:** https://www.artic.edu/artworks/153153
- **Public-domain image:** https://www.artic.edu/iiif/2/7bea5718-166b-7cdc-2ac1-5d9cc85b7bfa/full/400,/0/default.jpg
- **Research category:** Wallpaper

## Extracted source palette

`#F8E8C8, #282828, #886828, #584828, #A88838, #C89838, #E8D8A8, #786858`

The image was downsampled deterministically and quantized to a four-bit-per-channel histogram.
Colors were ranked by pixel population and de-duplicated by RGB distance. No random values are used.

## Semantic adaptation

- `background`: `#151515`
- `surface`: `#303030`
- `on_surface`: `#F8F8F6`
- `primary`: `#C89838`
- `on_primary`: `#0C0C0E`
- `secondary`: `#F8E8C8`
- `surface_variant`: `#303030`
- `on_surface_variant`: `#F8F8F6`
- `outline`: `#555554`
- `error`: `#C89838`
- `on_error`: `#0C0C0E`

- Font: `rounded` (chosen from source style/classification)
- Corner radius: `16dp` (chosen from source object/design classification)
- Body contrast: background `17.17:1`, surface `12.41:1`
- Variant contrast: `12.41:1`
- Control contrast: `7.45:1`

Backgrounds retain a source hue but are toned toward neutral only when needed to ensure body text is
at least 7.0:1. The primary action remains an extracted source color and its ink is chosen
for at least 4.5:1.
